'''"The Sarkans do.|Luke Skywalker and [[Rooz]]|}} The '''Sarkans''' were a [[species]] of [[Sentience|sentient]], [[egg]]-laying [[reptile]]s that hailed from the [[planet]] [[Sarka]]. ==Biology and appearance== Sarkans were tall bipedal [[reptile]]s with broad, tapered snouts, five-toed feet, and five-fingered hands with an opposable thumb. Except for the skull and tail [[bone]]s, their [[skeleton]] resembled that of [[human]]s. Their scaly skin boasted a variety of [[Color|tones]], including gray, red, orange, lilac, and green. Many Sarkans had mottled skin. They [[Reproduction|reproduced]] by laying [[egg]]s, and grouped themselves in family units called [[egg-brood]]s. ==Society and culture== {{Quote|The Sarkans are serious about their customs.|Leia Organa|}} The Sarkans lived underground, in vast caves where they [[Sarkan gem mine|mined]] various gems such as [[aqua jewel]]s and [[Corusca gem]]s. They were ruled over by a [[Monarchy|monarch]] seconded by an [[advisor]]. Sarkans typically wore colorful loose robes adorned with gemstones. According to [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], no species in [[the galaxy]] spent more time worrying about ritual and protocol than Sarkans. What made it difficult, even for seasoned [[diplomat]]s, was that they frequently came up with new customs, making it hard to keep up. ==History== The Sarkans hailed from [[Sarka]], a [[planet]] located in [[the galaxy]]'s [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]].[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]] During the [[Imperial Era]], they notably traded their gems with the [[Galactic Empire]], a galaxy-spanning autocratic regime led by [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]].''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' However, the anti-Imperial [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] needed gems for their [[laser cannon]], so they spent [[Standard month|months]] getting the Sarkans to agree to hold a summit. [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], the [[Princess]] of [[Alderaan]] and a leading figure in the Alliance, was sent to [[Sarka trade summit|meet]] [[Queen]] [[Zil]] of Sarka. However, due to a rough landing in the Sarkan caves, Organa twisted her ankle, which prevented her from meeting the queen on foot as she was supposed to. Therefore, the princess asked the star pilot [[Luke Skywalker]], hero of the [[Battle of Yavin]], to replace her. Little did they know that [[Lord]] [[Rooz]], the queen's [[advisor]], wanted nothing to do with the Alliance, instead hoping that the Empire would help him depose Queen Zil. Despite the advice of the [[protocol droid]] [[C-3PO]], Skywalker made faux pas after faux pas, until he drank from the queen's own goblet, the [[Sacred Chalice of the Caves]], and was thrown in [[Prison|jail]]. Meanwhile, as Princess Leia felt better, she decided to join the negotiations. Lord Rooz attempted to arrest her too on a charge of customs violation, but Organa's [[astromech droid]] [[R2-D2]] sprayed [[fire retardant]] on Rooz and his men, then shocked a pair of guards, which allowed the princess to escape. Organa and her astromech made their way to the tower prison, released Skywalker, and knocked out an Imperial operative that was questioning him. They then went to the throne room to see the Queen, but Rooz arrived at the same time to again arrest them for breaking into the prison and trying to escape. Princess Leia, however, turned the situation to her advantage. She claimed her rescue mission was actually a celebration of Sarkan culture, a reenactment of how Zil's great-great-great-grandmother broke into the tower to free Zil's great-great-grandfather in a tale of epic gallantry and honor. The Princess also revealed that Lord Rooz conspired with the Empire. Finally, C-3PO remarked that Rooz was standing on the royal seal, which was the greatest offense of all. The treacherous adviser was arrested, and the Sarkans agreed to supply the Alliance with gems from their mines. ==Sarkans in the galaxy== [[File:MelasSE.png|thumb|left|230px|The Sarkan Melas]] Circa [[232 BBY]],''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' dates the launch of the [[Starlight Beacon]] to 232 [[Standard year|years]] before the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which corresponds to [[232 BBY]] in the [[Galactic standard calendar|dating system]] used by ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''. As ''[[The High Republic: Into the Dark]]'' depicts the [[Dedication of the Starlight Beacon|launch]], its events, including the destruction of the ''[[Journeyman]]'', must occur around that year. several Sarkans were aboard the passenger [[starship]] ''[[Journeyman]]'' when it was struck by a piece of debris and had to be evacuated by the [[Jedi]].''[[The High Republic: Into the Dark]]'' In [[1 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' a turban-wearing, pipe-smoking Sarkan{{Film|IV}} known as [[Melas]]{{SWCT|set=Locations - Mos Eisley|cardname=Melas}} attended [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley]] when [[Luke Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] first met [[Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca]]. In the [[Standard year|year]] [[5 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]'' to [[5 ABY]]. a Sarkan named [[Vinthar]] was part of [[Eleodie Maracavanya]]'s [[pirate]] crew. ==Behind the scenes== A Sarkan first appeared as a puppet shot and edited into the cantina footage for the [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|Special Edition]] of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] in [[1997]]. The new creature, Melas, replaced the [[Defel]] [[Arleil Schous]]. The Sarkan puppet was actually the same puppet used for [[Ketwol]] the [[Pacithhip]], except turned around: the back of Ketwol's head became the Sarkan' face, while Ketwol's trunk and tusks were concealed by the Sarkan's turban.{{DB|character|melas|Melas}} ==Appearances== *[[The High Republic (2022) 1|''The High Republic'' (2022) 1]] *''[[The High Republic: Into the Dark]]'' {{Ab|The High Republic: Into the Dark (audiobook)}} *{{Film|IV}} {{1st}} {{C|Introduced in [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|''Special Edition'']]}} *{{IDWAdventuresCite-2017|annual=2018|story=Mind Your Manners}} *[[Darth Vader (2020) 15|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 15]] *[[Darth Vader (2020) 35|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 35]] *''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]'' {{Ab|Aftermath: Life Debt (audiobook)}} {{1stID|Sarkan}} ==Sources== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Sarkans}} *{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars By the Numbers|text=Every Alien Species in the Original Trilogy|video=yHVzcCGUM9U|nolive=1}} *{{SWKidsYouTube|series=Star Wars By the Numbers|text=Every Language in Star Wars Movies|video=CZp8Civk2co|nolive=1}} *''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Sarkano |fr=Sarkan |ja=サーカン }} [[Category:Mid Rim sentient species]] [[Category:Reptilian sentient species]] {{RelatedCategories |[[Category:Sarkans]] }}
